findings.title: mismatch_absent: audited v3 class matches the canonical v6 runtime Transcription process path
findings.description: The canonical v6 builder remaps `karr_transcription_v3` to the runtime key `karr_transcription`, so the audited file is now the actual executable path. The bound class is `KarrTranscriptionV3Process`, and it remains in the process inventory (not the step inventory), matching the intended activity semantics. `karr_transcription_v3.py` does not import or wrap `KarrTranscriptionProcess`, so v1 wrapper bugs are not transitively inherited through an import alias.
findings.suggested_canary: Add a v6 identity test asserting `composite.processes["karr_transcription"].__class__.__name__ == "KarrTranscriptionV3Process"` and `"karr_transcription" not in composite.steps`.

findings.title: mismatch_confirmed: v3 Transcription still bypasses allocator enrollment while consuming shared substrates
findings.description: The v3 process emits direct negative `substrates` deltas (`ATP/CTP/GTP/UTP`) and exposes no `requests` or `substrates_allocated` ports in its schema. The chassis allocation consumer list omits `karr_transcription`, and v6 reconfiguration only appends RNA decay to the consumer map. This leaves transcription demand outside `KarrAllocationStep` mediation and keeps the Track-A allocator defect active.
findings.suggested_canary: Fail CI when a process writes `substrates` and is absent from allocator `consumer_processes` unless an explicit ownership exemption is declared.

findings.title: mismatch_confirmed: v3 remains a calibrated deterministic rate model, not the Karr RNAP state-machine simulation
findings.description: Karr describes transcription as a stochastic four-state RNA polymerase Markov process with random transitions, explicit polymerase binding/elongation/termination, and state occupancy control. The v3 implementation computes gene synthesis from `predict_gene_synthesis_per_s`, applies a global calibration factor, and advances RNA via closed-form ODE integration. This is a deliberate mechanistic reduction and not a line-by-line Karr process replay.
findings.suggested_canary: Add a fixed-seed differential canary that compares RNAP state occupancy and TU transition events against MATLAB `Transcription.m` outputs.

findings.title: mismatch_confirmed: NTP draw is forced to equal 1/4 splits and omits side-product channels present in fixture metadata
findings.fixture_evidence: Fixture scalars expose substrate indices for ATP(1), ADP(9), diphosphate(10), water(11), and hydrogen(12), while v3 only emits ATP/CTP/GTP/UTP deltas via `per_ntp = total_nt / 4.0`.
findings.description: v3 computes total nucleotide polymerization and divides demand uniformly across ATP/CTP/GTP/UTP, independent of TU base composition heterogeneity. The update writes only those four channels and does not write ADP, diphosphate, water, or hydrogen side-products tracked by Karr process fixtures. Substrate-channel parity with Karr remains numerically unattainable under this formulation.
findings.suggested_canary: Add a substrate-channel differential test that fails when ATP/CTP/GTP/UTP remain exactly equal under heterogeneous sequence composition or when side-products never update.

findings.title: mismatch_absent: v3 runtime topology has downstream consumers for Transcription outputs and an upstream regulator feed
findings.description: In the v6 runtime topology, `karr_transcription` writes shared `rna`, `substrates`, and `tx_rate_fold_change` stores rather than isolated legacy ports. Downstream RNA-pathway processes (`karr_trna_aminoacylation`, `karr_rna_processing`, `karr_rna_modification`) explicitly read `rna.counts`, so transcription RNA output is not orphaned in this path. `karr_transcriptional_regulation` also writes `tx_rate_fold_change` keys that v3 transcription reads each tick.
findings.suggested_canary: Add a topology lint asserting every emitted non-diagnostic Transcription port has at least one reader in the canonical v6 composite.

findings.title: evidence_missing: fixture contract still blocks full tick-0 parity checks for v3 RNA state, despite partial substrate alignment
findings.fixture_evidence: load_per_process_fixture('Transcription') reports n_ticks=1 with inputs=0 and outputs=0; fixture arrays include `fixture__RNAs` shape (335,1) while v3 state uses 525 gene-level `rna.counts` plus `aminoacylated_counts`.
findings.description: The generic replay harness cannot construct state-before/state-after mappings for this process because the fixture lacks tick-labeled I/O channels. Additionally, fixture RNA payload is TU-oriented (335) and does not directly map to v3 gene-level + aminoacylated RNA stores, so complete `t=0` RNA parity remains unverifiable. Partial checks on mappable substrate channels do align (e.g., ATP/CTP/GTP/UTP values in v6 initial state match fixture substrate entries).
findings.suggested_canary: Export explicit `state_before/*` and `state_after/*` channels (or a process-specific key map) and require at least one RNA and one substrate parity assertion at tick 0.
